evaluation_graph: monthly attribute kNN graph data/processed/graphs/{period}.npz, binary convention of metrics.all_metrics
mixed_graph: attribute_graph_weight * attribute + (1 - weight) * road, unit mean strength per layer, binary convention; the graph temporal Leiden optimised; *_mix columns

omega_rule.aggregate: mean over 24 months and all seeds, MQ on the monthly attribute graph
omega_rule.choose: largest omega whose mean MQ is at least (1 - max_relative_drop) times the mean MQ at omega 0
